text.tspan: API access: keys, roles, tenants, quotas
Run store (SQLite / Postgres): migrations on open,
Keys come from [[api.keys]] by SHA-256 or env var; tenant '*' sees every tenant. Quotas: runs, tokens, cost per 24h, and concurrent runs.

g.text: Step 1 of 12 · A request arrives
Every route except /healthz and /readyz needs a bearer key.
Step 2 of 12 · Authenticate
The key's SHA-256 is compared in constant time; unknown -> 401.
Step 3 of 12 · Principal
The key names a principal with a tenant and a role.
Step 4 of 12 · Authorize
viewer reads; operator acts on runs; admin changes modes and rewinds.
Step 5 of 12 · Tenant isolation
Runs of other tenants answer 404, so their existence is not leaked.
Step 6 of 12 · Quotas
Runs, tokens, and cost per day and concurrent runs; over the limit -> 429.
Step 7 of 12 · Create the run
Stamped with the tenant and the key's name.
Step 8 of 12 · Enqueue
Workers on any host claim runs with leases.
Step 9 of 12 · Execute
A worker leases the run, executes it, and checkpoints every step.
Step 10 of 12 · Durable and masked
Secrets are masked in events as they are written.
Step 11 of 12 · Accountable decisions
Approvals and mode changes record which key acted.
Step 12 of 12 · Health
/readyz checks the store and reports the schema version.
